title.narrative: PIMS-9758 Advancing Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy Investments for Low-Emission Buildings in Egypt

description.narrative: The objective of the GEF PPG is to develop the project concept into a full project: Advancing Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy Investments for Low-Emission Buildings in Egypt. As described in the project concept PIF, this project aims to establish sustainable building model that reduces greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, enhances energy efficiency, and increases the use of renewable energy technologies. The project will introduce energy efficiency standards and green building standards and incentivize the adoption of distributed renewable energy solutions.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
